distinctness_hypothesis: Provisional class allocates bounded evaluation resource across many candidates and eliminates weak candidates early, rather than generating/mutating prompt text as the primary optimization signal. Public source semantics must confirm or falsify this before acceptance.

prior_use_audit.caveat: GitHub code-search reported incomplete_results=true; bounded duplicate check only.

precommitted_test: If public sources confirm budgeted successive elimination, map resource to a bounded count of scheduled-Chat evidence probes, not monetary/API quota. Precommit candidate set, stage budgets, elimination rule, same-scope score and deterministic ties. Elimination cannot itself create semantic credit; only independently read-back terminal evidence can. Include at least 10 guards and 4 ablations.
